title: South Korean cement demand to stay below 40Mt/yr in 2027
summary: South Korean cement demand to stay below 40Mt/yr in 2027
body_markdown:
**South Korea:** Domestic cement demand in South Korea will remain below 40Mt/yr in 2027, with the Korea Cement Association forecasting 39.7Mt/yr amid a construction downturn. Demand fell from 50.2Mt/yr in 2023 to 38.3Mt/yr in 2025, with shipments forecast at 38.7Mt/yr in 2026.


Hanil Cement’s sales fell from US$1.3bn in 2023 to US$1.1bn in 2025, while Asia Cement’s sales declined by 15% year-on-year. Hanil Cement reduced fixed costs through streamlined procurement and sales operations, raising it operating profit to US$10.6m in the first half of 2026, despite lower sales.


An industry official said “Unless something extraordinary happens to trigger a surge in demand, such as reunification of the two Koreas, it will be difficult for companies to see a meaningful improvement.”
